column2: The Nobel laureate returned to her hometown school to inspire students with stories of her experiments.
column3: 這位諾貝爾獎得主回到家鄉的學校，用自己的實驗故事激勵學生。
column5: laurel 月桂葉：古人用桂冠獎勵勝利者

column2: Professor Emeritus Chang still visits the lab each week, though he retired from teaching ten years ago.
column3: 張榮譽教授雖然十年前就退休不再授課，仍每週到實驗室走走。
column5: e 出 + merit 功績：功績滿滿、光榮退下

column2: The chancellor announced that the university would freeze tuition for the next two academic years.
column3: 大學校長宣布，未來兩個學年學費將凍漲。
column5: chancellor 像「千Sir-拉」：千位師生的大老闆

column2: As provost, she oversees all academic programs and works closely with each college's dean.
column3: 身為教務長，她監督所有學術課程，並與各學院院長密切合作。
column5: provost 像「破浮死」：負責管全校教學的二把手

column2: The dean of the medical college welcomed the new class and reminded them of their responsibilities.
column3: 醫學院院長歡迎新生，並提醒他們肩負的責任。
column5: dean 像「頂」：一個學院的頂頭人物

column2: My academic advisor helped me choose courses that fit both my interests and graduation requirements.
column3: 我的學術指導老師幫我選了既符合興趣又滿足畢業要求的課。
column5: advise 建議 + or 人：給你建議的人

column2: When Leo felt overwhelmed by exams, the school counselor taught him simple ways to manage stress.
column3: 當里歐被考試壓得喘不過氣，學校輔導員教他幾個管理壓力的簡單方法。
column5: council 議會＋ lor：你可以找他商量的人

column2: The librarian showed us how to search the database for peer-reviewed articles about renewable energy.
column3: 圖書館員教我們如何在資料庫中搜尋關於再生能源的同儕審查文章。
column4: ask a librarian (詢問圖書館員)
column5: library 圖書館 + an 人：圖書館裡的人

column2: The curator selected twenty paintings for the exhibition and wrote a short description beside each one.
column3: 策展人為展覽挑選了二十幅畫，並在每幅旁寫下簡短說明。
column5: cure 照料：照料展品的人，所以是館長或策展人

column2: A student who forgot to pay on time was told to visit the bursar to arrange a payment plan.
column3: 一名忘了準時繳費的學生被告知要找出納主任安排分期付款。
column5: bursar 像「爆煞」：錢一爆煞，就找管錢的人

column2: She filed a complaint with the campus ombudsperson, who investigated the dispute fairly and confidentially.
column3: 她向校園申訴專員提出投訴，專員公正且保密地調查了這起爭議。
column4: contact the ombudsperson (聯絡申訴專員)
column5: ombuds 代表 + person 人：替你說話的公正第三人

column2: A proctor walked between the desks to make sure no one looked at a classmate's paper.
column3: 一位監考員在座位間走動，確保沒有人偷看同學的考卷。
column5: proctor 像「怕客特」：怕你作弊，一直盯著你

column2: The invigilator collected the answer sheets as soon as the bell rang and counted them twice.
column3: 鈴聲一響，監考人員立刻收回答案卷並清點了兩次。
column5: in + vigil 警醒：醒著看守考場的人

column2: Because he was curious about philosophy, Ben decided to audit the course without taking the exams.
column3: 因為對哲學好奇，班決定旁聽這門課而不參加考試。
column5: audi 聽：用耳朵聽課但不考試

column2: The college agreed to waive the language requirement for students who had studied abroad for two years.
column3: 學院同意免除在國外讀過兩年書的學生的語言要求。
column5: waive 與 wave 同音：揮揮手，要求就免了

column2: Nina chose to defer her admission for a year so she could volunteer in a rural clinic.
column3: 妮娜選擇延後一年入學，好到偏鄉診所當志工。
column5: de 離開 + fer 帶：把日期帶到後面去

column2: If you withdraw from a class before the deadline, you will not receive a failing grade.
column3: 如果你在截止日之前退選一門課，就不會得到不及格的成績。
column4: withdraw from a course (退選課程)
column5: with 向後 + draw 拉：把自己從課裡往後拉出來

column2: Several students wrote to inquire about the scholarship deadline and the documents required.
column3: 幾位學生來信詢問獎學金截止日期與所需文件。
column5: in 向內 + quire 尋求：往裡尋求答案

column2: The teacher drew a diagram to clarify the difference between weather and climate.
column3: 老師畫了一張圖，釐清天氣與氣候之間的差別。
column5: clar 清楚（clear）+ ify 使成為：使變清楚

column2: At the end of class, the instructor reiterated that the final essay must cite at least five sources.
column3: 下課前，講師再次強調期末論文至少要引用五個來源。
column5: re 再 + iterate 重複：再重複一次

column2: Please summarize the main argument of the article in three sentences for tomorrow's discussion.
column3: 請為明天的討論，用三句話歸納這篇文章的主要論點。
column4: summarize the findings (總結研究發現)
column5: sum 總和：把內容加總成短短一段

column2: To avoid copying, Hana learned to paraphrase each source by restating its ideas in her own words.
column3: 為了避免抄襲，哈娜學會用自己的話重述每個來源的想法，也就是改寫。
column5: para 旁邊 + phrase 語句：在旁邊換個說法

column2: The ant colony exemplifies how simple individual behavior can create complex group organization.
column3: 蟻群是個典範，說明簡單的個體行為如何形成複雜的群體組織。
column5: example 例子 + ify 使成為：成為一個好例子

column2: The lecturer used a map of ancient trade routes to illustrate how ideas spread between cultures.
column3: 講師用古代貿易路線圖來說明思想如何在不同文化間傳播。
column4: illustrate a point (舉例說明一點)
column5: illustrate 像「依拉死追」：用圖片讓你一看就懂

column2: Could you elucidate the second step? I understood the first but got lost afterward.
column3: 你能把第二步講清楚嗎？第一步我懂，但之後就迷路了。
column5: e 出 + lucid 明亮：把話說到發光，讓人看懂

column2: In the lab, the teacher will demonstrate how to measure the acidity of a liquid with indicator paper.
column3: 在實驗室裡，老師會示範如何用試紙測量液體的酸度。
column5: de 完全 + monstr 顯示（monster 怪獸給人看）：秀出來給大家看

column2: In her opening chapter, the historian delineates the borders of the empire and the groups living inside them.
column3: 歷史學家在開篇章節中精確描繪出帝國的疆界與居住其中的各個群體。
column5: de 向下 + line 線：一筆一筆畫出線條

column2: The professor expounded on the causes of the French Revolution for nearly an hour without notes.
column3: 教授不看筆記，花了將近一小時詳細闡述法國大革命的成因。
column5: ex 往外 + pound 放：把想法一件件擺出來講

column2: Scientists can only speculate about what caused the dinosaurs' sudden decline, since direct evidence is scarce.
column3: 由於直接證據稀少，科學家只能推測恐龍突然衰退的原因。
column5: spec 看 + ulate：像在看遠處猜測

column2: Early astronomers could only conjecture that the moon was far larger than it appeared in the sky.
column3: 早期的天文學家只能猜想月亮比天空中看起來大得多。
column5: con 一起 + ject 丟：把想法一起丟出去，沒證據的猜測

column2: Einstein postulated that nothing travels faster than light, a claim that later experiments supported.
column3: 愛因斯坦假定沒有任何東西比光速更快，後來的實驗支持了這項主張。
column5: post 前面放 + late：先把前提放出來，當作假定

column2: Good researchers synthesize information from interviews, surveys, and old records into a single clear conclusion.
column3: 優秀的研究者會把訪談、調查與舊紀錄的資訊綜合成一個清楚的結論。
column5: syn 一起 + thesis 放置：把不同資料放在一起整合

column2: New fossil discoveries corroborate the theory that birds evolved from small dinosaurs.
column3: 新的化石發現證實了鳥類由小型恐龍演化而來的理論。
column5: cor 一起 + robor 力量（robust 強壯）：加強力量支持

column2: The author failed to substantiate her claim with data, so the committee asked for stronger proof.
column3: 作者沒能用數據證實她的主張，所以委員會要求更有力的證據。
column5: substance 實質：給論點添上實質內容

column2: In her paper, Dr. Rao tried to refute the old belief that heavier objects always fall faster.
column3: 拉奧博士在論文中試圖駁斥較重物體總是掉得較快的舊觀念。
column5: re 回 + fute 打：把對方論點打回去

column2: The new survey results contradict earlier reports, which had claimed that sleep has no effect on memory.
column3: 新的調查結果與先前主張睡眠對記憶沒有影響的報告相矛盾。
column5: contra 相反 + dict 說：說出相反的話

column2: The defense lawyer stood up to rebut each point the prosecutor had just made.
column3: 辯護律師站起來，逐一反駁檢察官剛才提出的每個論點。
column5: re 回 + but 但是：用「但是」頂回去

column2: After reviewing the data, the researcher had to concede that her original hypothesis was wrong.
column3: 檢視數據後，這位研究者不得不承認她最初的假設是錯的。
column5: con 完全 + cede 讓：退一步讓出來，承認對方說得對

column2: In the preface, the author acknowledges her advisor and the librarians who helped her find rare documents.
column3: 作者在序言中致謝指導教授，以及幫她找到珍貴文件的圖書館員。
column5: ac 朝向 + knowledge 知識：認可對方有知識貢獻

column2: The company disclaimed any responsibility for errors in the data that were provided by outside sources.
column3: 公司否認對外部來源提供的資料錯誤負有任何責任。
column5: dis 否 + claim 宣稱：不再宣稱屬於我
